context: Hiroshi (elder) has come in for his quarterly check. Dr. Saito is more familiar with him than with most patients — he's been retired into her clinic's rotation for years.
purpose: longstanding patient-doctor relationship — quiet professional warmth

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: こんにちは、加藤さん。お変わりないですか。
lines.en: Hello, Mr. Kato. How have you been?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely familiar greeting. The ease of a doctor who has known this patient for years. Professional but not perfunctory. Slight lean-in of actual care.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: おかげさまで。…まあ、年相応に。
lines.en: Thanks to your care. Well — aging as one does, I suppose.
lines.style: Measured, gentle delivery. A quiet smile underneath. Slight pause before the second thought — reflective, not complaining. The voice of someone comfortable with Dr. Saito.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 本当に、お元気そうで安心します。
lines.en: Truly — I'm relieved to see you doing so well.
lines.style: Honest warmth without performance. A genuine professional note, no hurry. The words land softly. Real care audible in the steadiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 先生のおかげですよ。…少し、咳が出るんですが。
lines.en: Thanks to you, Doctor. Though I have picked up a small cough.
lines.style: Careful, considered admission. Voice quiets on the confession. A small pause before mentioning it — not apologetic, but thoughtful. Testing the water.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.style: Professional pivot, attentive. Pen or notepad implied in the voice. No alarm, just focused clarity. The shift into doctor-mode, still gentle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 二週間ほど。心配は、していないんですが。
lines.en: About two weeks now. Nothing to worry about, I'm sure.
lines.style: Factual report with a small qualifier at the end. Voice steady but slightly defensive of his own dismissal. A man reassuring himself as much as the doctor.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 念のため、聴診器、当てましょうか。
lines.en: Just to be safe — shall we listen to your chest?
lines.style: Respectful, almost courteous phrasing. Genuine care without pressure. The stethoscope already in her hands, implied. Professional kindness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: もちろん、どうぞ。お時間、いつも、ありがとう。
lines.en: Of course, please. Thank you — truly — for always making the time.
lines.style: A small bow lives in the voice. Grateful formality underneath genuine affection. Practical — removes sweater. The politeness of someone from another generation, unforced.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: いえいえ、本当に、これが仕事。少しだけ、深呼吸。
lines.en: Not at all — truly, that's what I'm here for. Just take a slow deep breath for me.
lines.style: Grounded, settled warmth. The stethoscope cold against his skin, implied. Voice is present, not distant. A shared moment of care between doctor and patient.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: A real measured breath. Doctor and patient share the quiet. The sound of trust. No performance — just presence.
